SRC

Active Path: Steam Cumulus/Rococo Parachain
Source-backed architecture statement
The strongest defensible implementation story is Steam as a Cumulus/Rococo parachain:
`eave` binary -> CLI -> service -> Steam runtime -> Cumulus Aura collator -> relay chain.
source basis: eave-source-evidence-matrix.md | eave-architecture.md
